description: This file defines a static class 'DependencyInjection' that provides an extension method to configure dependency injection for the infrastructure layer of the Customer Management project. It sets up the database context with a SQLite connection and registers the customer repository with the dependency injection container.

classes.name: DependencyInjection
classes.description: Contains extension method for configuring infrastructure services in dependency injection.

methods.name: AddInfrastructure
methods.description: Configures database context and repository services for dependency injection, using environment variables and configuration for database connection string.
